# Vendored libraries

`qrcode.js` is **qrcode-generator 2.0.4** by Kazuhiko Arase, used unchanged to draw the join QR
code on the host screen without needing the internet in the classroom.

- Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator (npm package `qrcode-generator`, `dist/qrcode.js`)
- License: MIT (the notice is kept at the top of the file)
